signal.label: SELL
signal.buyer: Avoid buying now - wait for a dip.
signal.holder: Consider selling a part to book profit.

evidence.value: Forecast Rs 49,335 (-7.6%) vs bank interest 0.6% -> edge -8.2%
evidence.test: edge >= +3%: +2 | >= +1%: +1 | <= -1%: -1 | <= -3%: -2 (capped at 1 point: backtest error 10.7% is not better than no-change 8.8%)
evidence.source: Dharalu forecast (backtest error 10.69% vs no-change 8.8%, 244 tests)
evidence.why: Holding metal only pays if the expected rise beats the interest the money would earn.

evidence.value: Prices in Dec are usually +1.3% vs Oct (after removing the long trend)
evidence.source: Seasonal index from 9 years of prices (82% weight, rest = no season)
evidence.why: Indian demand peaks around Dhanteras, Diwali and the wedding season; world demand around Chinese New Year.

evidence.value: 7-day avg Rs 52,603 vs 30-day avg Rs 55,354; 30-day change -9.5%
evidence.source: World price x Rs rate (Yahoo Finance)
evidence.why: Prices tend to keep moving the way they are moving for a few weeks.

evidence.value: Price Rs 53,382 vs 200-day avg Rs 61,234; 50-day avg Rs 57,396
evidence.test: price and 50-day both above the 200-day: +1 | both below: -1
evidence.source: World price x Rs rate, last ~9 months
evidence.why: Metals move in long waves; going with the big trend avoids fighting it.

evidence.value: Today is higher than 24% of the last year's days (range Rs 45,142 - Rs 89,142)
evidence.source: World price x Rs rate, last 365 days
evidence.why: Buying in the cheap part of the yearly range limits risk.

evidence.source: World price x Rs rate, last 14 trading days
evidence.why: A very fast rise/fall often pauses or reverses.

evidence.value: Rs 94.92 per US$ vs Rs 95.80 a month ago (-0.9%)
evidence.why: Metal is priced in dollars: a falling rupee makes it dearer in India, a rising one cheaper.

forecast_reason.summary: Expected to fall about 7.6% in 30 days. Biggest reason: recent trend (-7.7%).
forecast_reason.telugu: 30 రోజుల్లో సుమారు 7.6% తగ్గవచ్చు. ప్రధాన కారణం: ఇటీవలి ధోరణి (-7.7%).

drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 11.3% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 0.7% higher in 30 days' time (Nov) than now (Oct).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is above the last 5 days' average, and the forecast counts a one-day jump only half, so it starts 0.6% lower than today.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -21.0% to +8.2% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 10.7% on average at 30 days, vs 8.8% for "price stays the same" - it is NOT better than no-change here, so read it as a range, not a number. Direction right 49% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.
